scope: Technical contract and verification plan for a neutral C derived from each pinned B design; no source or candidate image transformed by this analysis.

implementationTarget.writeStatus: Owned API/CLI module implemented; no production C outputs created by this agent.

methodDecision.transformationScope: Only RGB neutralization of new C derivatives. No geometry, alpha, source artwork or historical pack mutation.
methodDecision.fallbackIfTechnicalNotChosen: ImageGen only, but it cannot guarantee exact frame, contour or per-pixel alpha and must not claim those invariants.

neutralMeaning.channels: Every decoded pixel, including alpha0 and alpha1–9, has R=G=B in C.
neutralMeaning.appearance: Lit grayscale derivative of B: original placement, shading structure, dark/light boundaries and material contrast remain via an explicit scalar luma function.
notClaimed: PBR roughness, metallic, normals or UV maps
Canon, human validation, runtime integration or source-B artistic correction

deterministicMethod.inputDomain: Stored/decoded sRGB-encoded8-bit channel values; Rec709 luma coefficients, not linear-light relative luminance.
deterministicMethod.alphaRule: Raw decoded alpha bytes copied unchanged, including0,1–9 and antialias. Re-encoding PNG changes container bytes but must not change a single decoded alpha value.
deterministicMethod.frameRule: Identical native width/height, same pixel coordinates, no resize/crop/trim/rotate/auto-orient/flatten/threshold/quantization/palette conversion.
deterministicMethod.output: Lossless PNG RGBA8; explicit non-palette encoder; source B and A/R bytes untouched.
deterministicMethod.strictReuse: Byte-identical B reuse only if every pixel already R=G=B. No threshold-based near-gray admission.
deterministicMethod.colorProfileRule: Read stored native RGB without implicit ICC conversion; record source profile metadata and strip misleading colour metadata from the derived C. Verify raw channels and alpha independently after encoding.

availableProcessorObserved.resolution: Explicit checkout node_modules/sharp, or MASK_TOOL_DEPENDENCIES_ROOT existing project root; no ancestor/global fallback, installation or lockfile edit.

galleryPreviewContract.scope: Separate native-resolution review/customization gallery only, no game save writes or runtime imports.
galleryPreviewContract.colorInput: Normalized six-digit hex only, default neutral, reset restores C; no arbitrary image/URL input.
galleryPreviewContract.recommendedPreview: Display C with a local SVG feColorMatrix RGB-diagonal multiplier or equivalent native-size read-only Canvas mapping; alpha identity and transparent holes remain exact. Use an isolated element and retain B/C download links unmodified.
galleryPreviewContract.identityTint: #ffffff multiplier must produce identical C pixels; swatches#d2a65a,#3d86c6,#a357bd exercise warm/cool/purple.
galleryPreviewContract.contrastLimit: Global multiplier retains relative shading but darker/saturated swatches can darken highlights. It cannot assign independent coat/optics/bone/metal colours. A color-blend alternative may be offered only if separately labelled and visually checked.
galleryPreviewContract.statusLabels: Vapor provisional, Ravin hybrid, Emissary/Nightstorm partial remain visible in card/drawer and tinted preview. No color choice changes source review/qualification flags.

verificationPlan.name: Pinned source protection
checks: All66 B file SHA and A/R/workbook protection list stay unchanged before/after C output.
Selected manifest inventory contains exactly46+20 source design records and no duplicates/new aliases.
verificationPlan.why: Prevents unintended source replacement or counting source copies as new source designs.

verificationPlan.name: Pixel contract across every C
checks: Native width,height,RGBA8 mode match B exactly.
Every C pixel satisfiesR=G=B=the explicit integer luma of B.
Compare raw alpha arrays byte-for-byte and SHA256, not just bboxes/histograms; max difference0.
Alpha masks at1,10,16,240,255 and all-transparent holes must match exactly; alpha equality implies unchanged contours.
Already-gray reuse output SHA equals original B SHA; current inventory has0suchcases.
verificationPlan.why: Directly verifies the user-selected geometry/alpha and color-neutralization contract.

verificationPlan.name: Kernel edge cases
checks: All256neutral RGB triplets remain identical; alpha sentinel values0,1,9,10,15,16,239,240,254,255 are unchanged.
Invalid SHA, malformed source, source=destination, unsupported bitdepth and overwrite attempts fail without modifying sources.
verificationPlan.why: Catches coefficient/rounding/channel-order and filesystem admission errors.

verificationPlan.name: Recolor preview behavior
checks: Identity#ffffff returnsC; neutral/reset writes no B/C bytes.
Warm/cool/purple swatches alter visible RGB while preserving alpha/holes and readably retaining ridge/lens/grille regions at96/360px.

Keyboard hex controls, reset and drawer focus remain functional; no console errors or failed local assets.
